# Container

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Encapsulates a subgraph of operators. Visually groups child nodes.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/container",
  "type": "ContainerOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/container').par.in` (an input) and `op('/container').out.out` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.in`, `out.out`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->

|------|------|---------|

## Outputs
